research_scope: Five early/base-game skills selected after live repository duplicate checks. Acquisition identity is documented from current Xenoverse 2 references; unsupported reward-slot probabilities and technical fields remain unresolved.

verification_audit.source_policy: Repository code search returned zero matches for every selected skill. Current Xenoverse 2-specific references were preferred; older guide material is used only to corroborate quest identity.

records.name: Solar Flare
records.character_source: Time Patroller; also used by multiple characters
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 03 — World Tournament Tag Team
records.skill_description: A head blast that temporarily distracts/blinds nearby enemies.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference lists Solar Flare as an Other Super requiring 200 Ki and obtainable by completing PQ03. Exact reward-slot semantics are not asserted here.

records.name: Paralyze Beam
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 04 — Prepare for the Attack of Saiyans!
records.mechanics_notes: Current quest references list Paralyze Beam among PQ04's skill rewards. Exact Ki cost, detailed effect duration, and reward-slot semantics are intentionally unresolved pending a stronger skill-specific source.

records.name: Meteor Strike
records.skill_description: A two-hit Strike Super consisting of a launching kick followed by a finishing blow.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference lists Meteor Strike as a Strike Super, 100 Ki, and PQ06 as its acquisition source. The same reference documents a two-hit kick/teleport sequence. Exact reward-slot semantics remain unresolved.
records.combo_notes: The documented sequence uses a launching kick followed by a teleporting finishing kick.

records.name: Shine Shot
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 07 — Attack of the Saiyans
records.skill_description: A Ki Blast Super obtained from the early Saiyan-saga Parallel Quest pool.
records.mechanics_notes: Current quest lists consistently identify Shine Shot as a PQ07 skill reward. Exact resource cost, hit properties, and whether it is tied to a specific enemy or reward pool are left unresolved rather than inferred.

records.name: Wall of Defense
records.skill_description: A defensive/reinforcement Super from the early Saiyan-saga quest set.
records.mechanics_notes: Current quest references list Wall of Defense as a PQ10 skill reward. Exact classification details, resource cost, defensive modifiers, duration, and reward-slot semantics require a stronger skill-specific technical source and remain unresolved.
